messages.name: Certificate not issued
messages.description: A custom domain's certificate could not be issued or renewed (an alert).

default.subject: Sudoo.sh alert: no certificate for {{ domain }}
default.title: No certificate for {{ domain }}
default.body:
Hello,

The certificate of **{{ domain }}** (instance {{ instance }}) could not be issued or renewed:

{{ reason }}

The panel tries again on its own, waiting longer each time. Check the domain's DNS record and that ports 80 and 443 of the server are open, then choose Check now on the instance's Domains tab.

[Open the domains]({{ link }})

You receive this because alerts are sent to you (Settings, Alerts).

samples.reason: The ACME authority could not reach erp.client.com over http: connection refused.

messages.name: Certificate expires soon
messages.description: A custom domain's certificate expires soon and could not be renewed yet (an alert).

default.subject: Sudoo.sh alert: the certificate of {{ domain }} expires on {{ expires }}
default.title: Certificate of {{ domain }} expires soon
default.body:
Hello,

The certificate of **{{ domain }}** (instance {{ instance }}) expires on **{{ expires }}** and was not renewed yet:

{{ reason }}

After that date browsers warn visitors and refuse to open the instance through this domain. The panel keeps trying; fix what the reason says, then choose Check now on the instance's Domains tab.

[Open the domains]({{ link }})

You receive this because alerts are sent to you (Settings, Alerts).

samples.reason: It was not renewed yet: erp.client.com has no DNS record yet.

messages.name: Off-site copy failed
messages.description: A backup could not be copied off-site, or an off-site copy failed its check (an alert).

default.subject: Sudoo.sh alert: off-site copy of {{ instance }} failed
default.title: Off-site copy of {{ instance }} failed
default.body:
Hello,

An off-site copy of **{{ instance }}** ({{ copy }}) failed:

{{ reason }}

The backup on the server is not affected. If the storage refused the copy, check the off-site settings and choose Test connection (Settings, Backups); if a copy failed its check, it was changed or removed in the bucket ({{ storage }}): do not restore it, and look at who can write to the bucket.

[Open the backups]({{ link }})

You receive this because alerts are sent to you (Settings, Alerts).

placeholders.description: The instance the backup is of

placeholders.description: What went wrong, in a sentence

placeholders.description: The bucket and folder of the copies

messages.name: No recent off-site copy
messages.description: A production instance has had no successful off-site copy for too long (an alert).

default.subject: Sudoo.sh alert: no off-site copy of {{ instance }} for {{ hours }} hours
default.title: No off-site copy of {{ instance }} for {{ hours }} hours
default.body:
Hello,

Production instance **{{ instance }}** has had no successful off-site copy for {{ hours }} hours (last copy: {{ last_copy }}).

If the server were lost now, its newest backups would be lost with it. Check that its daily backup works and that the storage accepts copies (Settings, Backups, Test connection).

[Open the backups]({{ link }})

You receive this because alerts are sent to you (Settings, Alerts).

placeholders.description: Hours without a copy that start the alert

placeholders.name: last_copy
placeholders.description: When the last successful copy was made, or never

default.body:
Hello {{ name }},

**{{ who }}** asks for the role **{{ role }}** in **{{ stage }}** of **{{ project }}** for {{ hours }} hours.

**Why:** {{ reason }}

[Approve or refuse]({{ link }})

It ends by itself when the time is over.
